title_sq: SHITET BAR - KAFE BUZE RRUGE TEK TREGU ELEKTRIK

title_en: BAR FOR SALE - STREETSIDE COFFEE NEAR THE ELECTRIC MARKET
description_en: Bar-cafe business premises 190m2 for sale in the area of ​​Ali Demi at Tregu Elektrik. The facility is located on the side of the road. Currently it is a bar-cafe, it is an open space environment, 4 toilets and invested and furnished for a nightclub with acoustic insulation, ventilation system, music system. The premises are sold together with all the investment and furnishings inside. The bar also has a warehouse. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact us!
